subject: Bug ? Different behavior of updateSelectInput() and updateSliderInput()

messages.author: f8b7c6eae8e5aa1d
messages.subject: Bug ? Different behavior of updateSelectInput() and updateSliderInput()
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to build a dynamic UI, based on dynamical and customised user Tabs.
Each of those tabs would be of a predefined type, and thus, should have custom UI controllers.

To load those tabs, I save them in a reactiveValue, and call tabSet on all the items of this reactive list.

But I need to keep track of the settings that the user defined for each of the custom UI.
For this, I register the values (inside an observe) of the UI (selectInput and sliderInput) each time it's changed into another reactiveValues, and then, when loading back the tab, I update the values of the UI components based on those reactiveValues values.

My problem is that it works perfectly fine with the selectInput() / updateSelectInput(), but fails to work with sliderInput() / updateSliderInput().

I created a minimal reproducible example here :
https://gist.github.com/RCura/6c1d48f6141b239bd270
This can be run with :
library(shiny)
runGist('6c1d48f6141b239bd270')

To observe the bug, here's the procedure :
- Add a new select tab, change its value (for example put 2)
- Add a new tab (anyone) : the previous tab value is still the one you chose (2)

- Add a new slider tab, change its value (2 again for example)
- A a new tab (anyone) : the value of the previous tab has been reset to 1 (default value)

I have to precise that the code of slider and select tabs are quite exactly the same.

Any idea why it's happening ? I looked into the source code of updateSelect/Slider/input, but can't find any hint.

Hope someone can help me, I think it's really usefull to be able to keep those renderUI values, and furthermore, it should allow me to serialize their values, and thus, to have an app that can get saved/loaded as an external file :)


Cheers,

Robin
